label: Farm indicators by age and sex of the manager, economic size of the farm, utilised agricultural area and NUTS 2 region

label.KE_GE0_LT2: Zero euros or over to less than 2 000 euros

label.HA_GT0_LT5: Over 0 ha to less than 5 ha

extension.description: The manager of the agricultural holding is the person responsible for the normal daily financial and production routines of the holding. Statistics on the manager’s age and sex help analyse the demographic structure of farm management, including generational renewal and gender balance in agriculture. Farm indicators measure key characteristics of agricultural holdings, such as farm size and type of farming. This table includes information on the number of agricultural holdings, hectares of utilised agricultural area (UAA), annual working units (AWU), livestock units (LSU) and economic output (standard output - SO), by managers’ age class and sex, class of economic output (standard output - SO) of the farm and class of utilised agricultural area (UAA), at regional (NUTS 2) level. Annual work unit (AWU) is the full-time equivalent employment, i.e. the total hours worked divided by the average annual hours worked in full-time jobs in the country. One annual work unit corresponds to the work performed by one person who is occupied on an agricultural holding on a full-time basis. The standard output is the average monetary value of the agricultural output at farm-gate price, in euro per hectare or per head of livestock. Information is based on censuses and sample surveys.
